newsitem.title: USA: Star Multi Care Services to close deal.
newsitem.headline: Star Multi Care Services to close deal.

text.p: Star Multi Care Services Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to close its previously announced acquisition of Extended Family Care Corp in the next 60 days.
Under the terms of the transaction, Star will pay a total of $7.25 million in cash and shares of its common stock for the home health service company.
In a statement, Star said Extended Family had 1996 annual revenues of $8.9 million; Star's proforma revenue for the first year of operation after the acquisition is anticipated at $62 to $65 million.
